metaDescription: Kevin says it alarms him that Pam Bondi, who he says bungled a major conspiracy, is the government's liaison to frontier AI labs.
summary: Kevin asks whether anyone else is terrified that Pam Bondi, whom he says bungled the most important conspiracy of our lifetime, is the liaison between the government and the frontier AI labs. He describes those labs as building the most powerful and least controlled technology ever made. Kevin calls Bondi supposedly the last line of defense and says the situation is bad.
